topic: Door Rear Left Lamp Control Commands and Parameters
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific command or parameter related to the control of the rear left door ambient lamp, including its on/off state, color, brightness, and breathing rate.

column_semantics.Input: The source or type of input signal (e.g., LIN bus, internal system request)
column_semantics.LIN: Signal from the Local Interconnect Network bus
column_semantics.LHZCU: Signal from the Left Hand Zone Control Unit
column_semantics.DoorAmbtLampD_RL: Signal related to the Door Ambient Lamp Driver for the Right Left side
column_semantics.LHZCU_LIN4: Signal from the LHZCU via LIN4 interface

core_entities.name: DoorRL4LampOnOff_1
core_entities.description: Controls the on/off state of the rear left door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorRL4LampColorCmd_1
core_entities.description: Sets the color of the rear left door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorRL4LampBrtnsCmd_1
core_entities.description: Adjusts the brightness of the rear left door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorRL4LampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Configures the breathing rate of the rear left door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: LHZCU
core_entities.description: Left Hand Zone Control Unit, responsible for processing commands and controlling the lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorAmbtLampD_RL
core_entities.description: Door Ambient Lamp Driver for the Right Left side, directly controls the lamp.

core_entities.name: LIN
core_entities.description: Local Interconnect Network bus signal used for communication between modules.

core_conditions.name: Breathing Rate Command
core_conditions.description: 0x0-0xB=Rate levels from No Request to Rate11

core_outputs.name: DoorAmbtLampD_RL
core_outputs.description: Output signal to the lamp driver to execute the commanded state.

core_outputs.name: 内灯SSTS
core_outputs.description: Status signal indicating the current state of the internal light.

core_timing_constraints.name: Fade Speed
core_timing_constraints.description: Time required to transition from current to target state when changing lamp color or brightness.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the command structure and parameters for controlling the rear left door ambient lamp's on/off state, color, brightness, and breathing rate. It is used to verify that the system correctly interprets and executes these commands through various input interfaces (LIN, LHZCU) and updates the lamp driver accordingly.
